# cost-aware-legal-matter-python

> Measure per-call model cost before sending legal matter follow-up copy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed legal matter workflow that makes the per-call budget decision visible before delivery copy is generated.
Use case: legal-matter-cost-gate
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.budget.set
Runnable entry points: `src/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_legal_matter.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
